The Ranisa way

Made to feel like yours.

Ranisa Boutique in Dehradun creates ethnic dresses, with a focus on sari-inspired designs. Choose a style and discuss the fabric, details and measurements that suit you. You can also bring your own material for stitching.

Ready sizes include free size, S, M, L and XL, with custom measurements available. Custom-made pieces are non-returnable.
